faq.label: [TRANSLATE:Russian] FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.title: [TRANSLATE:Russian] Got Questions?
faq.a1: [TRANSLATE:Russian] Most WhatsApp Business API providers charge a per-conversation fee (like ₹1.25 per conversation) on top of Meta's official pricing. CartRenew charges ZERO platform markup — you only pay Meta's official WhatsApp pricing. This saves high-volume stores ₹3,000-₹15,000 per month.
faq.q2: [TRANSLATE:Russian] Do I need a credit card for the 14-day trial?
faq.a2: [TRANSLATE:Russian] No credit card required. Sign up with your email, connect your Shopify store, and start recovering abandoned carts instantly. You only pay when you choose a plan after the trial ends.
faq.q3: [TRANSLATE:Russian] How does the auto-withdrawal work for international payouts?
faq.a3: [TRANSLATE:Russian] For global customers, we process payouts via Stripe. Your recovered revenue is tracked in real-time and payouts are automatically processed to your connected bank account every Monday. No manual withdrawal needed.
faq.q4: [TRANSLATE:Russian] Can I use CartRenew without Shopify?
faq.a4: [TRANSLATE:Russian] Currently, CartRenew integrates directly with Shopify and WooCommerce. We're building custom API support for other platforms. Join our waitlist for early access to custom integrations.
faq.q5: [TRANSLATE:Russian] How does the AI multilingual messaging work?
faq.a5: [TRANSLATE:Russian] Our AI engine detects the customer's region and language preference from their Shopify profile. It then crafts personalized recovery messages in Hinglish, Hindi, English, or other supported languages. The tone adapts based on cart value and customer history.
faq.a6: [TRANSLATE:Russian] Absolutely. We're SOC 2 Type II compliant and use end-to-end encryption for all data. Your customer data never leaves your infrastructure — we use secure webhooks and never store payment information.
